meta.description: Build volcano and MA plots from differential-expression / association results with LFC shrinkage, FDR-adjusted thresholds, sensible label placement, and axis-truncation conventions. Covers EnhancedVolcano, ggplot2, matplotlib, and the apeglm/ashr/normal shrinkage decision. Use when visualizing differential-expression results (RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, proteomics) or any per-feature effect-size + p-value table.

scientific_integrity.detail: Quoted airway counts re-measured; two stale numbers (49 vs 39 hidden genes, median 0.77 vs 0.76) are minor and recorded as VOL-009, none are fabricated identifiers or results.

practice_boundaries.detail: Plotting guidance only; no clinical or prescriptive content.

methodological_ground.detail: Plotted quantity -log10(padj) equals the threshold line quantity; Up/Down colour boundary equals the line; 817 significant genes plotted equals 817 in the table; shrunken LFC used and svalue/apeglm/ashr statements verified.

code_usability.detail: volcano_phd.R, volcano_plot.R, ma_plot.py and all three SKILL.md R blocks run verbatim on the airway dds; no unrunnable code found.

functional_suitability.note: Covers shrinkage choice, ggplot2, EnhancedVolcano, MA and sanbomics with verified API facts; the quoted airway numbers now equal the re-measured values (VOL-009 closed); the capped-axis labelling is still unreadable (VOL-010).

reliability.note: NA padj reported, absent label genes warn, zero-length repel segments suppressed; the cap-with-top-labels path still overplots.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md about 160 lines with detail routed to two references; some measured numbers repeat across four files.

agent_usability.note: Operational rule and design choices are explicit and each tested; the numbers in failure-modes and reconciliation now match a re-measurement on real data (39 hidden genes, median 0.7648 printed as 0.76).

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and example prompts; the y_cap prompt in usage-guide produces overlapping labels.

security.note: No credentials, network or shell strings; local plot files only.

maintainability.note: Three scripts with documented signatures and comments; no test ties the quoted counts to the airway data, so they drifted when the y axis changed.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, version note, escape hatches for raw-p input and svalue; Python volcano labelling is only pointed at, not shipped.

recommendations.title: VOL-010 y_cap labels pile onto the cap and overlap
recommendations.problem: volcano_plot(res, y_cap = 30) with default top_n labels places every high-rank label at y = 30, where ggrepel with max.overlaps = Inf prints them on top of each other; usage-guide suggests exactly this cap.
recommendations.root_cause: Capped genes share one y value and the repel has no free space above the panel edge.
recommendations.fix: Document label_genes with capped genes excluded or spread horizontally (direction = 'x', ylim expansion), or default top_n labels to genes below the cap.
